title: I will build a custom discord bot with advanced features
description:
Transform your Discord server with a custom bot built just for you. From simple commands to complex automation — I've got you covered.

✅ FEATURES I CAN ADD:
• Custom commands & response automation
• Moderation tools (auto-mod, warn, kick, ban)
• Music playback & queue management
• Leveling & reward systems
• Ticket system & support bot
• Integration with Google Sheets, Notion, Trello
• Database-backed features

📦 DELIVERABLES:
• Complete Python source code
• Setup guide & documentation
• 30-day bug fix support

basic.desc: Basic bot: welcome messages, basic commands.

standard.desc: Advanced bot: moderation, music, leveling, custom commands.

premium.desc: Premium bot: database, API integrations, analytics dashboard, 24/7 hosting setup.
